channel.title: CVE Daily — AI Curated
channel.description: Today's curated vulnerabilities highlight a significant concentration of critical flaws in web applications and database middleware, where attackers can achieve remote code execution, authentication bypasses, and unauthorized administrative access across platforms like dotCMS, LogicalDOC, and Red Hat Foreman. Network infrastructure remains at risk through a Juniper Junos OS denial-of-service vulnerability and an OpenVPN identity impersonation flaw, while cloud services face threats from hardcoded credentials in Vanus and SSO bypasses in BMC Helix. Additionally, emerging technologies including AI model deployment tools and IoT firmware update mechanisms exhibit severe weaknesses such as code injection, heap corruption, and improper certificate validation that could compromise system integrity and privacy.

item.title: CVE-2026-14765 — Desktop OS
item.description: Epic Games Unreal Engine's insecure default configuration for the LaunchURL Blueprint node permits all URL schemes, which can lead to local file access or malicious redirects on Windows desktop systems.

item.title: CVE-2026-96424 — Mobile Security
item.description: An incorrect DBus policy in Ubports' lomiri-upload-manager allows any local user to read arbitrary files as root, severely compromising mobile device privacy and integrity.

item.title: CVE-2026-109399 — IoT Security
item.description: SWUpdate improperly validates X.509 certificates during firmware chain building, enabling attackers with sibling intermediate keys to push malicious updates to embedded devices.

item.title: CVE-2026-111998 — Cloud Security
item.description: Vanus event streaming platform contains hardcoded default credentials that grant unauthenticated remote attackers full cluster-admin access to manage namespaces and tokens.

item.title: CVE-2026-111283 — Cloud Security
item.description: BMC Helix Network Management suffers from an authentication bypass when SAML SSO is configured, allowing attackers to log in as the local administrator with any password.

item.title: CVE-2026-101940 — Network Devices
item.description: Juniper Networks Junos OS routing daemon contains a NULL pointer dereference exploitable by BGP peers to trigger denial-of-service conditions on critical network infrastructure.

item.title: CVE-2026-84790 — Network Devices
item.description: OpenVPN allows authenticated users to impersonate other identities via crafted certificate subject fields, undermining secure remote access controls.

item.title: CVE-2026-108707 — Web Security
item.description: Wukong_HRM features a critical authentication bypass in its ParamAspect middleware, granting unauthenticated attackers full administrative access to sensitive HR data.

item.title: CVE-2026-16337 — Web Security
item.description: dotCMS REST/DWR endpoints allow low-privileged backend users to self-assign administrative roles, directly leading to remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-109321 — Web Security
item.description: GetGrav's OAuth plugin provisions accounts with unsalted MD5 passwords and deterministic usernames, facilitating mass account takeovers via leaked credential databases.

item.title: CVE-2026-109199 — Web Security
item.description: LogicalDOC Community Edition allows authenticated users to execute OS commands by injecting malicious Velocity templates into document email subjects.

item.title: CVE-2026-109286 — Web Security
item.description: Open WebUI's cross-origin message handling flaw enables any website to steal authenticated user session tokens, compromising AI chat platform security.

item.title: CVE-2026-109894 — Web Security
item.description: Arraytics Booktics contains a severe SQL injection vulnerability in its checkout parameters, allowing attackers to extract or manipulate database contents.

item.title: CVE-2026-104736 — Web Security
item.description: Thimpress LearnPress WordPress plugin deserializes untrusted input during checkout, enabling remote attackers to achieve object injection and arbitrary code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-110886 — Web Security
item.description: QuantumCloud Conversational Forms for ChatBot suffers from deserialization of untrusted data, allowing attackers to inject objects and compromise chatbot integrations.

item.title: CVE-2026-112005 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: WhoDB's query editor exposes DuckDB filesystem functions without proper restrictions, allowing authenticated attackers to perform path traversal and read/write host files.

item.title: CVE-2026-96658 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: Red Hat Foreman's template rendering engine safemode bypass allows low-privileged users to execute arbitrary code on the underlying management server.

item.title: CVE-2026-109227 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: SGLang's video preprocessing allocates unbounded memory by decoding frames at full resolution, enabling remote denial-of-service attacks on LLM inference deployments.

item.title: CVE-2026-108553 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: OpenRefine's get-rows command contains a CSRF flaw that lures users into executing arbitrary Jython facet expressions, resulting in operating system command execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-111991 — Other
item.description: YOLOv9's ONNX Metadata Handler suffers from code injection via manipulated argument names, posing risks to edge AI model deployment pipelines.

item.title: CVE-2026-111986 — Other
item.description: AUTOMATIC1111 stable-diffusion-webui contains a code injection vulnerability in its model instantiation component, allowing remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via crafted targets.

item.title: CVE-2026-112021 — Other
item.description: snac2's JSON lexer contains a heap-based buffer overflow triggered by crafted escape sequences, enabling remote memory corruption via ActivityPub endpoints.

item.title: CVE-2026-112018 — Other
item.description: cgltf's accessor unpacking function performs unchecked sparse index operations, allowing attackers to corrupt heap memory through malicious glTF/GLB files.
